name: Kady Youth Sheep Camp — Fiscal Sponsorship, Brand & Web
fmv_basis: FMV ~$11,000 — midpoint of a most-likely $10–12k, from roughly 85–150 hours at $75–150/hr. Right comparable is a skilled freelancer or small studio building custom ($8–14k), not a template site ($4–6k) and not a branding agency ($18–30k+). Scope: bespoke design system with shared component layer and brand-mark integration; 9 hand-coded pages (Home, Our Story, Gallery, Calendar, Partners, Support, Press, Contact, Thank-you); custom UX components — hero, creation chain, family timeline, apprentices grid, seasonal calendar, gallery lightbox, press editorial cards, partner directory, donation tiers; substantial original copywriting; wired contact form; responsive across desktop, tablet, portrait and landscape phone; FMV/quid-pro-quo donation structure through Confluence; Vercel deploy, clean URLs, redirects, OG tags, security headers; many revision rounds. Full range $8–18k.

name: Mo'Betta Green MarketPlace — Website, Hosting & Digital Fundraising
River Sisters · Hermanas del Río — Brand, Bilingual Web & Advocacy
fmv_basis: FMV ~$25,000 — roughly 180–220 hours at prevailing Denver small-studio rates (~$110–140/hr). Scope: 1,392 lines hand-written HTML/CSS plus ~850 lines custom JS, no framework or template; fully bilingual (142 translated string pairs, custom runtime toggle rather than a plugin); 7 content sections; 28 member cards with interactive detail panel; 9 partner logos; 8 custom SVG icons; 11 media queries; 129 aria attributes of real accessibility work; the Turquoise Necklace feature — bespoke SVG map of 23 parks plus a MapLibre GL scrollytelling sidecar with curated per-park content, commonly quoted $8–20k as a standalone deliverable. 66 commits over two months of stakeholder iteration. Comparable bands: nonprofit-discounted $12–18k; small studio $22–30k; agency $40–60k. REDUCING FACTORS, to be disclosed in any writeup: no CMS (content is hand-edited HTML, so staff cannot update it themselves), and the brand identity came from the Congreso rather than being designed here.

name: Confluence Colorado — Brand, Web & Grant Platform
fmv_basis: FMV ~$45,000, and plausibly higher. Brand identity built from nothing — logo, visual language, messaging — then website design and launch, then a custom grant management platform (split out of the WA OMP into its own repo and Supabase project per ADR-009), plus ongoing technology infrastructure management and grant management strategy. Comparables from the same book: River Sisters $25,000 for brand + bilingual site + interactive map; Kady $11,000 for a 9-page bespoke site. Confluence exceeds both and adds a custom platform and continuing management, which neither comparable includes. $3,000 was paid, against the website work only. NOT a charitable deduction for WA — donated services never are; the figure is for the recipient books and for rate-setting.
